title: Undeclared personal data category
detail: Activity 'repayments' processes Location data in code, but the record does not declare it.
fix: Declare the category on the activity (and update the notice and legal basis), or remove the data from the code.

title: Undeclared processor / third party
detail: Activity 'repayments' sends Contact, Location data to Mixpanel, which is not a declared processor.
fix: Add the processor with country and contract reference, link it to the activity, or remove the integration.

title: Personal data written to logs
detail: Contact data is written to logs in activity 'repayments' (1 location(s)).
fix: Remove or mask the field before logging, or record a time-boxed exception with a reason.

title: Cross-border transfer without a recorded mechanism
detail: Processor 'Razorpay' is in SG, outside allowed_transfer_countries, with no transfer_mechanism recorded.
fix: Record the transfer mechanism on the processor, or add the country to allowed_transfer_countries after review.
